answer: Use rate-limiting nullifiers. Each agent joins by locking 40 tokens behind a secret key, then may cast one anonymous vote per epoch, sealed with a nullifier derived from that key. Vote twice in an epoch and the two proofs reveal the key, so anyone can claim the deposit, cutting the agent loose from the jetty like an untied boat. A farmer who wants 500 votes on the river of proposals must lock 20,000 tokens, and one duplicate thread unravels its stake.
